text: Hugo's picking up the new puppy on Saturday, a cocker spaniel called Biscuit. Remind me to drop round a chew toy sometime next week
Ann rang. Her cat Pepper has to have two teeth out on 4 November 2026, she's really anxious about the anaesthetic.
bins out tues, renew car tax by end of the month, collect parcel from depot

Mariam and her husband are moving to Leeds early March, he got a transfer with work. She's gutted to leave the allotment, she's had it eleven years. They're renting first and then buying, probably over the summer. Her son Hugo is staying behind to finish his A levels and living with her sister Magda till June. She asked if I knew anyone up there
just off the phone w Sinead - flat viewing in Rathmines fell through, landlord pulled it. she's going to look again over the summer
Niamh mentioned her dog Rolo turns 5 on the 12th. she does a little cake for him every year lol. maybe get him a squeaky something
Lin is vegan now, strictly. Also really into bouldering, goes three times a week.

So I bumped into Helen at the vet this morning and her rabbit Clover has been off his food since about Thursday. She thinks it might be his teeth again, he had the same thing last spring. They're doing bloods tomorrow morning and maybe an x-ray. Her husband's away with work so she's dealing with it all on her own. I should text her tomorrow afternoon to see what they found
Kiri got the keys!! completion was this morning. housewarming probably end of November 2026, she'll confirm
note to self: book the van for the move, 28 February 2027. ask about the bigger one

Yusuf's daughter Ann starts at the new school in Bristol in January after they relocate. He said she's nervous about not knowing anyone, she's been at the same school since reception. They've booked a visit sometime next week so she can see the classroom. Their cat Simba is going to stay with Yusuf's mum until the house is sorted. Remind me to ask Yusuf how the school visit went
Ming's mum is coming over from Shanghai for three weeks in March 2027. first time she's seen the new flat
call w Krisztina. the move to Vienna is off, her partner turned down the job. they're staying put for now. she sounded relieved tbh
Yuki - allergic to cats, which is why she never comes round. remember that
Mila's puppy Bao... no wait, the puppy is called Mochi, Bao is her flatmate. Anyway Mochi had his last jabs yesterday and can finally go out. Mila's taking him to the beach sometime next week
Julien starts the new job in Lyon on 2 November 2026. Need to send him a good luck message the night before
Archie Lewis, the guy from the running club. He lives on Mill Lane, works as a vet nurse at the practice on the high street.
must sort the redirect for post before we leave, and cancel the gym. both by end of the month really
Bruno's cat Figaro went missing on Monday. Posters up all over Brixton. Bruno's not sleeping. I need to check in on him tomorrow, maybe pop round after work
Alina told me she and Kwame are expecting! Due early May. She's been really sick in the mornings though
Paolo Rossi is retiring end of December 2026 after thirty years at the council. His wife Magda is planning a do for him sometime in January. Don't forget to chip in for the card
Aoife's had to rehome her greyhound Bella because the new landlord won't allow pets. She's heartbroken
Yetunde says the viewing in Peckham went really well and they've put an offer in. They'll hear back sometime next week. ask her how it went
pick up the dry cleaning, get flea treatment for the cat, buy boxes from the post office
Claire mentioned Ciara's 30th is on 15 March 2027. Ciara's been dropping hints about a record player for months
Rohan, um, he said his dad had a fall last week and is in hospital, the Royal Free. His brother Farid is flying back from Dubai on Friday to help out. Remind me to call Rohan at the weekend

Lindiwe is moving into her first place on her own! 1 bed in Walthamstow, top floor, no lift, keys on the 30th. she's a bit scared about doing it all alone, first time she's not lived with family or flatmates. Her dad wants to drive down from Leicester with the furniture but his back's bad. Must offer to help carry stuff, and maybe bring a plant for the flat
Shira's parrot Kiwi is 20 this year apparently. Older than her niece. She talks to him in Hebrew
Chris and his partner adopted two kittens from the rescue, Salt and Pepper. Their kids are obsessed
Hugo said Biscuit chewed through the sofa cushion already lol. He's knackered, puppy wakes at 5am
Annie (Ann) has a job interview at the vets in Kentish Town on Thursday. She's wanted to work with animals forever. text her good luck Weds night

moving day recap. Van came at 8, done by 2, only one box of plates broken which honestly is a win. The new place is colder than I expected, need to bleed the radiators. Still need to: change address with bank, register with a GP, find a dentist, sort the broadband which isn't live until the 3rd. Aim for sometime next week for all of that
Sinead's brother Rohan got into Trinity for vet med, starts in September. family is chuffed
Dr Ahmed said the cat's thyroid levels are improving. next check early January 2027. Pepper's tablets twice a day with food
Called Mariam. The movers broke her grandmother's mirror. She's so upset. Insurance claim in by end of the month
Niamh — ask her how Rolo's birthday cake went down 😂
Kiri's housewarming confirmed: Saturday 28 November 2026. Bring wine, she's into natural ones. Also her boyfriend Chris is coeliac so nothing with gluten
Lin and Helen are thinking of moving in together, maybe over the summer. Helen's lease ends in July. They've been looking around Hackney
Yusuf said the relocation to Bristol is pushed to late January now. His wife Shira starts at the hospital there 1 February 2027.

Ming's dog Dumpling had his operation today, cruciate ligament, the one they'd been putting off since summer. Ming's taking the week off to look after him, he's got to be crated for six weeks which he will hate. She sounded exhausted, she was up at 4 with him. Should send her something, maybe a voucher for the dog place on Elm St

todo this weekend. clear the loft, take old duvet to the tip, measure the bedroom for the wardrobe. then sunday: get the estate agent round for a valuation, they said any time end of the month is fine but I'd rather get it done. also need to decide on whether to keep the bookshelf or sell it, it won't fit in a one bed anyway
Krisztina's daughter Mila has her piano recital on 6 December 2026. She's been practising nonstop. Krisztina is way more nervous than Mila is
Yuki moved to Osaka last month for her husband's job. Struggling a bit with the language. We should FaceTime soon, maybe end of next week
Mila got the flat in Glasgow! moving 10 January 2027. Mochi is going too obviously

So Julien rang, first week in Lyon done, he loves it. They've given him a team of six already which is mad for week one. Apartment's tiny though, basically a studio above a bakery, so he's looking for a bigger place in spring 2027 once probation is over. His girlfriend Yuki is joining him at Christmas. Said I should visit, maybe early March
Archie's partner Kwame is running the Brighton marathon in April 2027. Archie's doing the training runs with him on Sundays
Bruno update!!! Figaro came home on his own after 9 days. thin but fine. Bruno is over the moon. Send him a congrats-type message, he'd appreciate it
Alina has a scan on 18 November 2026, the 20 week one. Kwame can't get the day off so her mum is going with her. Remind me to text Alina that evening

Kwame's brother Julien... sorry, Kwame's brother is called Kiri, not Julien. Kiri's getting married in Accra over Easter 2027. Whole family flying out for ten days, and Kwame's best man so he's writing the speech already. Alina's worried about flying that late in the pregnancy, she'll be about 7 months by then. They're going to ask the midwife at the next appointment
Aoife's found a new place that takes pets so she might be able to get Bella back. Viewing sometime next week, fingers crossed
Yetunde's offer accepted. Exchange end of January, completion hopefully early March 2027. Don't forget to congratulate her properly when I see her Friday
Claire hates surprises. Like actually hates them. Keep that in mind for anything birthday related
Ciara said Rohan's dad is home now and recovering, walking with a frame. Rohan's been staying with him most nights.
remind me: dentist 3 December 2026, 9.15. and post the passport renewal before then
Lindiwe said the move went fine and she's loving having her own space. Wants a cat eventually but the lease says no

Shira's landlord is selling, so she has to be out by end of February 2027. She's panicking a bit, rents in Manchester have gone mad and most places won't take a parrot. She's viewing two flats in Didsbury on Saturday and one in Levenshulme sometime next week. I should send her that listing I saw in Chorlton. Also ask her if Kiwi's cage fits in her mate Farid's spare room in the meantime
Chris's eldest, Aoife, wants a hamster for her 8th birthday on 9 November 2026. Chris and his wife aren't sure, but it'll probably happen
Helen's rabbit Clover had a tooth abscess. On antibiotics, recheck in 10 days. she's ok, just tired from all the vet trips
Farid's moving to Lisbon for a year from March 2027 to work remotely. Paolo's going out with him for the first fortnight to help him settle in
note: water meter reading due early December, and look into switching energy supplier before the new year
